name: mix_vocal_air
character: A voice made brighter without the harshness: a de-esser first, then a slight tilt up and a touch of tape.
provenance: starting value, not a measurement. Sources: knowledgebase/sound-design/mixing-techniques.md (parallel compression, de-essing 4-7 kHz, ducking by the dry signal, mid-side with mono lows, distortion on a return, gates with hold; MusicRadar, iZotope, Sonarworks, Fiveable).
